title: PACHA Malware Investigation
description: Investigate and respond to the PACHA malware infection on the target systems.
outcomes: Usage of systemd for service management
Usage of iptables for network filtering
Investigation of log files and system processes

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The PACHA malware is a Linux server infection that uses coinminers and employs various techniques for persistence, exfiltration, and command and control (C2) communication. Your task is to investigate and respond to this malware infection on the target systems.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host via SSH using the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.
levels.local_content: Access the target host via SSH using the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: The PACHA malware uses a service for its malicious activities. Investigate the target host to identify this suspicious service. The flag is the name of the service.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services running on the target host. The suspicious service is payload-transfer.service.

hints.title: Check systemd services
hints.content: Check the systemd services running on the target host.

levels.title: Investigate Data Exfiltration
levels.content: The PACHA malware exfiltrates data from the infected host. Investigate the target host to identify the file used for data exfiltration. The flag is the full path to the file.
levels.solution: Check the logs and files in the home directory of the user cyrano. The file used for data exfiltration is payload-transfer.log.

hints.title: Inspect user home directory
hints.content: Check the logs and files in the home directory of the user cyrano.

levels.title: Contain C2 Communication
levels.content: The PACHA malware communicates with a C2 server using a specific port. Identify and block this port to contain the malware's activities. The flag is the port number.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and open ports on the target host. The port used for C2 communication is 8080. Block this port using iptables.

hints.title: Check network connections
hints.content: Check the network connections and open ports on the target host.
